conclusions: Recorded trial UI exposed only the generic warning Token count failed. No quota, format, project or processing cause was visible.
The history access error is a separate observed blocker and does not establish the cause of token count failure.
File names displayed in attachment UI matched each explicitly selected file path. Local sizes and hashes are recorded; backend receipt of those bytes was not independently verified.
The HTML video players reported duration 6 s, readyState 4 and no error before each Run. This establishes local browser playback readiness only.
Actual rendered player frames and any warning tooltip could not be reinspected after the original tabs were closed. No local reconstructed frame is substituted for that evidence.
